linked_or_non_linked.value: linked-base term rider (UIN series A); rider premium paid with the base premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: Rider due premiums are required to be paid along with the base policy premium.

waiver_of_premium.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
waiver_of_premium.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

critical_illness.value: No critical illness benefit. Terminal illness accelerates the death benefit.
critical_illness.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
critical_illness.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

accidental_death.value: not covered separately; death from any cause is covered by the term cover.
accidental_death.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
accidental_death.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

accidental_disability.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
accidental_disability.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

term_cover.value: On death or diagnosis of terminal illness, whichever is first, a lump sum of the higher of the rider sum assured or 105% of total rider premiums paid. Rider sum assured at most 100% of the base plan sum assured.
term_cover.quote: Sum Assured on Death or terminal illness will be the highest of

hospital_cash.quote: Additional Life cover over and above the base policy at nominal premium
hospital_cash.note: The rider is a term cover with terminal illness acceleration only.

other.value: Lower premium for female lives. Inbuilt health management services.

rider_term.value: Minimum 6 years, maximum 55 years; maximum maturity age 80.

premium_paying_rules.value: Limited pay 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 15 or 20 years. Modes as the base plan. Can be opted at base policy inception. Rider premium may not exceed 30% of the base premium.

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 5,00,000. Maximum per board-approved underwriting policy, at most 100% of the base plan sum assured.

premium_deduction.value: Separate rider premium paid along with the base policy premium.
premium_deduction.quote: Rider due premiums are required to be paid along with the base policy premium.
